title: Acquire and validate complete Smart 451 body geometry
body:
## Problem and scope

Replace educational exterior surfaces with redistribution-approved U.S. 451 Passion coupe geometry.

## Acceptance criteria

Record license, creator and source; compare wheelbase, dimensions, door/glass/panel outlines against photographs and measurements; preserve semantic component roots; attach reviewer evidence before Tier B/A promotion.

## Baseline

The initial AutoAtlas release contains Tier C educational geometry and no confirmed OEM fitment for the selected gasoline configuration. Do not promote accuracy or fitment without evidence. See docs/ROADMAP.md and ASSET_LICENSES.md.

title: Design evidence-backed replacement-part marketplace integration
body:
## Problem and scope

Add compatible alternatives and current availability only with appropriate provider access.

## Acceptance criteria

Choose licensed APIs, confirm terms, provenance, fitment and timestamps; keep identity separate from compatibility; test unavailable/stale data; never infer fitment from broad product titles or VIN attributes alone.

## Baseline
